topic: Carrier logistics from Bellevue, WA 98007 to candidate markets (SoCal, Maui/Honolulu, Anchorage, Dallas, Miami, Eugene, Spokane, Boise): transit commitments, 2026 published rates, surcharges, drop-off/return-leg logistics, Alaska Air Cargo GoldStreak, discounts, claims, disruption risk
summary:
Facts first. (1) "Overnight" to Hawaii is not overnight for most of the lab's realistic options. FedEx's 2026 list-rate tables carry separate Alaska/Hawaii zones (9/10 metro, 11/12 rural) and footnotes: Express Saver is not offered to AK/HI at all; Standard Overnight is "Alaska metro only"; 2Day A.M. is "Alaska only"; Priority Overnight and 2Day are the Hawaii-inbound workhorses, and the FedEx service guide language is "delivery in 2 business days for certain shipments to and from Alaska and Hawaii" (Priority Overnight) and "3 business days for certain shipments" (2Day). UPS's 2026 zone files confirm the mirror image: from the 48 states, only Next Day Air, 2nd Day Air and Ground are offered to AK/HI (zones 124/224/44 metro; 126/226/46 extended); Next Day Air Saver, 2nd Day Air A.M. and 3 Day Select are not. Kahului 96732, Kihei 96753 and Lahaina 96761 fall in UPS's extended tier; Honolulu 968xx and Anchorage 995xx are metro. UPS's own guide says Next Day Air to Hawaii "may require additional time in transit"; Next Day Air Early is explicitly committed to Anchorage by 8:30/9:00 a.m. Saturday delivery in Hawaii (FedEx) is Oahu-only, select ZIPs.

(2) Published 2026 list prices for a 1 lb crown box, with the fuel surcharge in force the week of Oct 5, 2026 (FedEx Express 31.75%, Ground 29.25%; UPS Air 32.25%, Ground 29.75%): Bellevue to Maui, UPS Next Day Air ~$169 (list) or ~$101 under UPS's published Small Business Rates; UPS 2nd Day Air ~$108 list / ~$71 SBR; FedEx Priority Overnight ~$172-177; FedEx 2Day ~$90 (metro) to ~$115 (rural). Bellevue to Anchorage is priced identically to Hawaii metro at both carriers (FedEx PO ~$172, UPS NDA ~$168, UPS 2DA ~$89). Within the contiguous states the same box runs FedEx Priority Overnight ~$88 (zone 3, Eugene/Spokane est.) to ~$150 (zone 8, Miami); UPS 2nd Day Air ~$38-62; Ground ~$16-20. The cheapest credible expedited options to the islands are flat-rate products that bundle fuel: FedEx One Rate 2Day small box is $19.55 nationwide including AK/HI (FedEx packaging only; 2Day to HI/AK can be 3 business days and carries no money-back guarantee); UPS Simple Rate 2nd Day Air extra-small box is $48.80 to metro AK/HI and $90.05 to remote AK/HI, no fuel surcharge.

(3) Alaska Air Cargo GoldStreak is the only true same-day product. Oct 1, 2026 tariff: SEA (zone 4) to OGG/HNL (zone 11) letter $59, minimum $99 (1-3 lb all pay the minimum at $3.44/lb); SEA to ANC (zone 2) letter $49, minimum $74; SEA to Orange County (SNA, zone 6) letter $49, minimum $69; DFW/MIA $79. Tender 60 minutes before departure, pickup 60 minutes after arrival, airport-to-airport only; the consignee (dentist or courier) must collect at the cargo building (OGG: 871 Haleakala Hwy, M-F 6:00 am-7:30 pm, Sat-Sun 6:00 am-1:00 pm; ANC and SEA GoldStreak 24/7). Alaska runs four SEA-OGG nonstops daily (first 08:07) and roughly 10+ SEA-ANC, so a case tendered by ~7 am can be in a Maui dentist's hands early afternoon HST. Known Shipper status is mandatory and Integra already holds it. Caveats: the guarantee requires pre-booking and only refunds up to 50% of the charge; the public rules tariff caps pieces at 100 lb while the website says 150 lb; prepaid only; rates rose ~$5 per minimum between January and October 2026.

(4) Cutoffs matter more than rates. Nearest FedEx Office (1299 156th Ave NE) last Express pickup 4:00 pm M-F per a June 2026 aggregator; The UPS Store at Crossroads (15600 NE 8th St) 5:00-5:30 pm air pickup; the UPS Customer Center in Redmond shows conflicting open/closed status. Return legs are the trap: FedEx Ship Center Kahului last Express drop-off is noon M-F; FedEx Anchorage 2:30 pm; Lahaina OfficeMax 11:00 am; UPS Stores on Maui 5:00 pm M-F with no weekend air pickup. Return-leg list rates are lower than outbound (FedEx Priority Overnight from AK/HI 1 lb $78.45 list, ~$103 with fuel; FedEx/UPS 2Day/2DA ~$58-60).

(5) Money-back guarantees: FedEx reinstated its guarantee Jan 13, 2026 only for First/Priority/Standard Overnight and 2Day A.M.; 2Day, Express Saver and Ground remain unguaranteed. UPS's guarantee covers only Next Day Air Early/NDA/NDA Saver/2DA A.M.; 2nd Day Air, 3 Day Select and Ground are suspended (UPS's own year-end notice). So the two services most likely to be used to Maui (FedEx 2Day, UPS 2nd Day Air) carry no refund if late. Default liability is $100 per package; declared value above that costs FedEx $4.95 ($100.01-300) then $1.65 per $100; UPS $5.10-5.11 then $1.70 per $100 (a $1,700 arch: ~$28-29). Damage claims must be noticed within 60 days at both carriers.

Estimates: Eugene/Spokane assumed zone 3 (zone 4 possible), Dallas zone 7 (8 possible), Aliso Viejo UPS zone 5 (published from the reverse 926 chart; FedEx zone 5 assumed), Boise zone 4, Miami zone 8. UPS Hawaii-origin pages were not retrieved; Alaska-origin tables are used as proxy because FedEx and UPS AK/HI figures match to the cent. Pirate Ship publishes no AK/HI rate table ("up to 75% off Daily Rates" for air; AK/HI "may incur UPS surcharges"); the UPS Small Business Rate Guide is used as the proxy for a discounted small-shipper tier.

Unknowns: whether the Maui ZIPs are FedEx "Hawaii rural" (zone 12), whether they sit on either carrier's Alaska/Hawaii delivery-area-surcharge list (FedEx $16.25 HI/$46.00 AK; UPS $16.50/$48.25), exact UPS zones from 980 (file not retrievable), the nearest FedEx Ship Center to Bellevue, and GoldStreak pricing for Boise/Eugene/Spokane (zone 9 is absent from the GoldStreak chart). Disruption record for the Hawaii lanes is real but episodic: Maui wildfire flight delays (Aug 2023), Aloha Air Cargo weather suspensions at OGG/KOA (Mar 2026), Hurricane Lala (Aug 2026), the UPS Louisville MD-11 crash (Nov 2025) that suspended guarantees, and USPS pushing Hawaii Ground Advantage to 10+ days from Oct 1, 2026.

findings.claim: GoldStreak operating rules
findings.detail: Next-available-flight, U.S. domestic, no pre-booking required; tender at cargo facility 60 minutes before departure; available for consignee pickup 60 minutes after arrival at the destination airport cargo office; airport-to-airport only (no delivery). Guarantee: if not available within 2 hours of arrival, up to 50% of the service charge refunded, but only if booked in advance; weather/ATC excluded; claims within 7 days. Rules tariff: pieces over 100 lb not accepted, max 70 in. length, 90 linear inches; website says up to 150 lb per piece (conflict). Minimum charge = letter rate. GoldStreak shipments must be prepaid. All stations cashless. Shipper must be a TSA Known Shipper or use a TSA-approved forwarder; Alaska requires an annual physical site verification (fees apply) to maintain individual Known Shipper status.
findings.source_date: undated tariff; service page undated; known-shipper page undated; accessed 2026-10-12
findings.value: 60 min before / 60 min after; 100 lb (tariff) vs 150 lb (web)

findings.detail: FedEx suspended its guarantee Dec 1, 2025 (MD-11 fleet reviews) and reinstated it Jan 13, 2026 only for First Overnight, Priority Overnight, Standard Overnight, 2Day A.M. and Extra Hours contract services (international Feb 12, 2026); FedEx 2Day, Express Saver, Ground and Home Delivery remain unguaranteed 'until further notice' (Service Guide eff. Feb 12, 2026). UPS Service Guarantee is 'in effect for select Air and International services but is otherwise suspended' (UPS year-end notice); third-party summary: covers Next Day Air Early, Next Day Air, Next Day Air Saver, 2nd Day Air A.M.; NDA residential commitment extended to 12:00 pm and Saver to end of day. Refund requests must be filed within 15 days at both carriers.
findings.source_date: 2026-09-06 (also shipkeep.com undated; UPS year-end schedule PDF; legalclarity.org 2026-03-14); accessed 2026-10-12
findings.value: FedEx 2Day and UPS 2nd Day Air: no guarantee

findings.claim: Claims windows and norms
findings.detail: UPS Tariff 55.3: notice of loss/damage within 60 days of delivery or scheduled delivery; claim filed within 9 months (domestic); UPS pays, declines or offers within 120 days; payment documents due within 9 months; typical processing 8-15 business days after documents; original packaging must be retained for inspection; three photos required; serial numbers for electronics over $500. FedEx: damage/missing-contents claims within 60 calendar days (U.S.), non-delivery within 9 months of tender; typical resolution 5-7 business days; default liability $100/package; FedEx Ground declared value max $1,000, Express up to $50,000. Carriers exclude consequential damages (lost chair time) in all cases.
findings.source_date: UPS Tariff undated (current); corepiper.com 2026-04-13; accessed 2026-10-12
findings.value: 60-day damage notice; 9-month filing; $100 default

findings.claim: UPS 2026 holiday operations and 2025-26 peak transit changes
findings.detail: UPS closed Thanksgiving Nov 26, 2026, Christmas Dec 25, Jan 1, 2027; Dec 24 and Dec 31 air delivery only with pickups prearranged by Dec 18/Dec 28. 2025-26 year-end notice: Nov 28-Dec 31 Next Day Air Early extended 90 minutes; NDA/2DA A.M. commercial commitments extended to 3:00 pm; NDA residential to end of day; some 2nd Day Air (tendered Dec 15-17) and 3 Day Select packages need an extra day; Ground extra transit Nov 17, 2025-Jan 9, 2026. FedEx 2026 holiday schedule PDFs exist but fedex.com blocked retrieval.

findings.claim: Documented Hawaii/Alaska lane disruptions (2023-2026)
findings.detail: Aug 10, 2023 Maui wildfires: Alaska Air delayed flights, United cancelled OGG flights; FedEx could not ship palletized freight into Maui and routed via Honolulu. Mar 9-14, 2026: Aloha Air Cargo suspended operations and cancelled all OGG/KOA flights for severe weather; Hilo closed for volcanic ash. Aug 19, 2026 Hurricane Lala: Hawaii Island post offices closed, deliveries paused. Sep 24-25, 2026 tropical storm: Big Island port closed to vessels. Nov 4, 2025 UPS MD-11 crash at Louisville (Honolulu-bound) triggered suspension of the UPS guarantee. Dec 2024: Alaska Air Cargo temporarily suspended OGG and LIH cargo stations (since restored). Mar 13, 2026: SEA winter weather delays for Alaska Air Cargo. Oct 1, 2026: USPS extended Ground Advantage to Hawaii to 10+ days (sub-pound parcels moved by sea).
findings.source_date: 2026-03-09 (Aloha); Reuters 2023-08-10; Hawaii News Now 2026-08-19; Star-Advertiser 2025-11-07; Hawaii Business 2026-10-07; accessed 2026-10-12
